lines.text: Jump into a hole through the Earth, and you'd reach the other side in 42 minutes.

phrases.text: Jump into a hole through the Earth,
and you'd reach the other side in 42 minutes.

lines.text: What if you jumped into a hole straight through the Earth?

phrases.text: What if you jumped into a hole straight through the Earth?

lines.text: First, you'd fall through the crust: about 35 kilometers of solid rock.

phrases.text: First, you'd fall through the crust:
about 35 kilometers of solid rock.

lines.text: Then the mantle: nearly 3,000 kilometers of hot rock.

phrases.text: Then the mantle:
nearly 3,000 kilometers of hot rock.

lines.text: Next, the outer core, an ocean of liquid iron.

phrases.text: Next, the outer core,
an ocean of liquid iron.

lines.text: The inner core is about as hot as the surface of the Sun.

phrases.text: The inner core is about as hot as the surface of the Sun.

lines.text: With no air to slow you, you'd pass the center at about 8 kilometers a second.

phrases.text: With no air to slow you,
you'd pass the center at about 8 kilometers a second.

lines.text: That's roughly 8 times faster than a rifle bullet.

phrases.text: That's roughly 8 times faster than a rifle bullet.

lines.text: Then gravity flips, and starts slowing you down.

phrases.text: Then gravity flips,
and starts slowing you down.

lines.text: You coast up the other side and reach the surface, 12,700 kilometers away.

phrases.text: You coast up the other side
and reach the surface, 12,700 kilometers away.

lines.text: Unless someone grabs you, you fall straight back in.

lines.text: The whole trip takes about 42 minutes.

phrases.text: The whole trip takes about 42 minutes.

lines.text: And in the simplest model, a straight tunnel between any two cities takes the same time.

lines.text: London to New York? Also about 42 minutes.
